goal: Eliminate routine operator copy/paste for review request/disposition plumbing while preserving exact-target binding and independent-review semantics.
non_goals: No Lambda, systemd, runner, reconciler, controller, registry, manifest, capacity, maintenance, or automatic-merge mutation.
No authority-sensitive self-approval by the authoring process.
No claim that GitHub identity cryptographically proves a fresh ChatGPT session.

authority_sensitive.note: Fresh-session independence remains a procedural review contract; the automation makes it durable and machine-checkable.

routine_code.copilot_requirement: Only APPROVED at the exact requested head is consumable; COMMENTED is not acceptance.

request_protocol.changed_path_binding: SHA256 over canonical sorted path/blob pairs; deleted paths bind as DELETED.
request_protocol.trusted_requester_execution: Write-capable request creation is triggered only by issue_comment, whose workflow and github.sha resolve to the default branch. The trusted default-branch script inspects a separate PR-head checkout as Git data only; workflow_dispatch is forbidden.

disposition_protocol.comment_attestation: Only fresh_independent_session is accepted in issue-comment dispositions. copilot_approval is never accepted from comments.

consumption.routine_copilot_exact_head_approved: Only via GitHub PR review API after request_copilot=true; a trusted issue_comment consume command may re-check pending Copilot state.

runtime_boundary: GitHub-only; no Lambda/controller credentials or live runtime mutation.

same_executor_fallback.applies_when: owning workflow intentionally does not require independent review for a consequential mutation
required_behavior: same executor reviews authoritative state, exact mutation scope, implementation/control path, relevant failure modes, and existing validation before mutation
known blocking findings must be resolved before mutation
failed consequential mutation requires post-failure state inspection and a new same-executor review before retry
non_substitution: does not bypass an explicit independent-review gate
same_executor_fallback.execution_model: single executor may perform design→self-review→implement→run→inspect→patch→rerun when independent review is deliberately omitted
